title: Trump Rants: ‘Let Them Go Back to Where They Came From’

sentences.zh: 在太空中度过七十年。

sentences.en: From The New York Times, I'm Natalie Kittrowev.
sentences.zh: 我是来自《纽约时报》的娜塔莉·基特罗夫。

sentences.en: This is The Daily.
sentences.zh: 这里是《每日新闻》栏目。

sentences.en: These aren't people that work.
sentences.zh: 这些人可不是在工作。

sentences.en: These aren't people that say, let's go.
sentences.zh: 这些人不是那种说“我们走吧”的人。

sentences.en: Come on, let's make this place great.
sentences.zh: 来吧，让我们把这个地方建设得更好。

sentences.en: These are people that do nothing but complain.
sentences.zh: 这些人除了抱怨什么都不做。

sentences.en: During a cabinet meeting on Tuesday,
sentences.zh: 在周二的一次内阁会议上，

sentences.en: President Trump delivered perhaps the most blatantly xenophobic public remarks of his political career.
sentences.zh: 特朗普总统发表了其政治生涯中可以说是最公然排外的公开言论。

sentences.en: And we're going to go the wrong way if we keep taking in garbage into our country.
sentences.zh: 如果我们继续把垃圾引进我们的国家，我们就会走向歧途。

sentences.en: Attacking Somali Americans in Minnesota and calling them garbage.
sentences.zh: 他攻击明尼苏达州的索马里裔美国人，称他们为垃圾。

sentences.en: You know, they came from paradise and they said, this isn't paradise.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，他们来自天堂，然后他们说，这不是天堂。

sentences.en: But when they come from hell and they complain and do nothing but bitch,
sentences.zh: 但当他们来自地狱，却只会抱怨和满腹牢骚时，

sentences.en: we don't want them in our country.
sentences.zh: 我们不欢迎他们来到我们的国家。

sentences.en: Let them go back to where they came from and fix it.
sentences.zh: 让他们回他们来的地方去，把那里整顿好吧。

sentences.en: Today, my colleague Ernesto Londano on the story of how Somalis became the president's
sentences.zh: 今天，我的同事埃内斯托·隆达诺将带我们了解索马里人是如何成为总统的最新目标的，

sentences.en: latest target in his ongoing effort to reshape America's relationship to its immigrant communities.
sentences.zh: 这是他重塑美国与其移民社区关系这一持续努力的一部分。

sentences.en: It's Thursday, December 4th.
sentences.zh: 今天是12月4日，星期四。

sentences.en: Ernesto, the president's comments about Somali immigrants this week were, I think for a lot of us, truly shocking.
sentences.zh: 埃内斯托，总统本周关于索马里移民的言论，对我们许多人来说，我想真的是令人震惊的。

sentences.en: Even for a president who's known for making extreme comments about immigrants.
sentences.zh: 即使对于一位以发表针对移民的极端言论而闻名的总统来说也是如此。

sentences.en: He called an entire group of people garbage in a nationally televised cabinet meeting.
sentences.zh: 他在全国电视转播的内阁会议上，把整整一个群体的人称为垃圾。

sentences.en: You're in Minnesota as a national correspondent.
sentences.zh: 你作为国家记者正在明尼苏达州。

sentences.en: So tell us, how were these comments received there?
sentences.zh: 那么请告诉我们，这些言论在那里是如何被看待的？

sentences.en: I think people here have been shell-shocked by the comments.
sentences.zh: 我认为这里的人们对这些言论感到震惊不已。

sentences.en: I think they're not surprised that the president would say things that are disparaging of the Somali community or about his immigration philosophy.
sentences.zh: 我想他们并不惊讶总统会说出贬低索马里社区或其移民哲学的话。

sentences.en: But I do think the tone and tenor of what was said at the White House yesterday struck people here as just beyond the pale.
sentences.zh: 但我确实认为，昨天白宫言论的基调和声调，让这里的人们觉得简直无法无天、太过分了。

sentences.en: And it's induced a prevailing sense of terror among the 80,000 or so people of Somali ancestry
sentences.zh: 这在居住在该州的约8万名索马里血统居民中引发了一种普遍的恐惧感，

sentences.en: that live in the state, the vast majority of whom are American citizens or legal permanent residents.
sentences.zh: 他们绝大多数是美国公民或合法永久居民。

sentences.en: And they're a big part of the fabric of Minnesota.
sentences.zh: 他们是明尼苏达州社会结构的重要组成部分。

sentences.en: They're ascendant in politics.
sentences.zh: 他们在政坛上崭露头角。

sentences.en: There's many Somali Americans who are in the state legislature and hold other local office.
sentences.zh: 有许多索马里裔美国人在州议会任职并担任其他地方公职。

sentences.en: They are business owners.
sentences.zh: 他们是企业主。

sentences.en: They work blue-collar jobs.
sentences.zh: 他们从事蓝领工作。

sentences.en: They work in health care.
sentences.zh: 他们在医疗保健行业工作。

sentences.en: And the idea that overnight their president refers to them as garbage and says that he wishes they would just all go home was truly jarring.
sentences.zh: 一觉醒来，他们的总统竟然称他们为垃圾，并表示希望他们统统回家，这种想法实在是令人感到极其刺耳。

sentences.en: Tell me about the terror that you described.
sentences.zh: 跟我讲讲你所描述的那种恐惧吧。

sentences.en: What is prompting the fear in the community specifically?
sentences.zh: 究竟是什么引发了社区内的这种恐惧？

sentences.en: This week, we learned that the Trump administration has deployed roughly 100 immigration agents to come in and apparently look for Somalis who are subject to deportation orders.
sentences.zh: 本周，我们得知特朗普政府已经部署了大约100名移民特工进驻，显然是为了寻找面临驱逐令的索马里人。

sentences.en: As we understand that, this is a fairly small pool of people.
sentences.zh: 据我们了解，这是一个相当小的群体。

sentences.en: We're talking about maybe a few hundred people who have pending asylum cases.
sentences.zh: 我们讨论的可能只有几百名有未决庇护案件的人。

sentences.en: Or for whatever reason, came here legally but fell out of status because they may have committed a crime.
sentences.zh: 或者由于某种原因，他们合法来到这里，但由于可能犯罪而失去了合法身份。

sentences.en: So what's happened is there's a sense that a crackdown on immigration is starting to take
sentences.zh: 所以发生的情况是，人们感觉到针对移民的镇压开始在明尼苏达州扎根，

sentences.en: root in Minnesota and that businesses and homes may become the targets of immigration raids.
sentences.zh: 企业的住所和家庭可能会成为移民搜查的目标。

sentences.en: What this has meant so far is that people are thinking twice about whether they feel safe
sentences.zh: 到目前为止，这意味着人们在考虑是否觉得自己有安全感去上班时变得三思而后行，

sentences.en: going to work, even if they have legal status, and just people kind of mulling whether they even feel comfortable going to the grocery store.
sentences.zh: 即使他们拥有合法身份，人们甚至还在琢磨自己去杂货店是否还感到自在。

sentences.en: And the fear is not merely about running into immigration agents.
sentences.zh: 这种恐惧不仅在于遇到移民特工。

sentences.en: The fear also has become that this prevailing toxic rhetoric about Somalis and Somali culture
sentences.zh: 这种恐惧也变成了：围绕索马里人和索马里文化的这种弥漫的恶劣言论，

sentences.en: has empowered people who are racist to do and say things that amount to harassment and hatred.
sentences.zh: 已经赋予了那些种族主义者做出并说出构成骚扰和仇恨行为的底气。

sentences.en: I spoke to a Somali-American immigration lawyer who said he's been flooded with calls, including from American citizens who report just being taunted and harassed on the street.
sentences.zh: 我采访了一位索马里裔美国移民律师，他说他接到了大量电话，其中包括报告自己在街上被嘲弄和骚扰的美国公民。

sentences.en: You're saying people are seeing this as potentially giving people permission to act on their worst instincts?
sentences.zh: 你的意思是，人们认为这可能是在变相默许人们顺从他们最糟糕的本能行事？

sentences.en: It's a permission structure.
sentences.zh: 这就是一个纵容的结构。

sentences.en: Correct.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: I want to talk about why this is happening, why the federal government has turned its attention to this community of 80,000 people.
sentences.zh: 我想谈谈为什么会发生这种情况，为什么联邦政府将注意力转向了这个拥有8万人的社区。

sentences.en: In his diatribe, Trump hinted at the reason for the hostility.
sentences.zh: 在其长篇大论中，特朗普暗示了这种敌意的原因。

sentences.en: He said that Somalis had stolen all of this money.
sentences.zh: 他说索马里人偷了所有的这些钱。

sentences.en: This is a story you've been covering, right?
sentences.zh: 这是你一直在报道的一个故事，对吧？

sentences.en: Walk us through how Somalis became the subject of this vitriolic attack from the president.
sentences.zh: 给我们梳理一下，索马里人是如何成为总统这种恶毒攻击的对象的？

sentences.en: Yeah, I think the origin of this saga dates back to 2020.
sentences.zh: 是的，我认为这场风波的起源可以追溯到2020年。

sentences.en: And what happened was, you know, during the early weeks of the pandemic, state officials were really worried about whether people were being fed, were people going to be housed,
sentences.zh: 当时发生的事情是，你知道，在大流行的初期，由于许多人失业，

sentences.en: as many lost their jobs.
sentences.zh: 州官员非常担心人们是否能吃饱饭，是否能有地方住。

sentences.en: And as we all sort of collectively descended into this fearful moment induced by COVID-19, And there was one specific program that state officials were managing to keep vulnerable
sentences.zh: 正当我们所有人都一同陷入由新冠肺炎引发的这种充满恐惧的时刻时，有一个特定的项目，州官员一直在管理它，以确保脆弱的儿童在大流行期间有饭吃。

sentences.en: kids fed during the pandemic.
sentences.zh: 项目的英文大写

sentences.en: What happened was that turned into a magnet for fraudsters who began registering as meal sites saying that they were feeding tens of thousands of children when in reality what
sentences.zh: 发生的事情是，这成了一个吸引骗子的磁石，他们开始注册为供餐点，声称他们正在喂养数万名儿童，而实际上他们做的是提交虚假发票并窃取了惊人数量的资金。

sentences.en: they were doing was submitting bogus invoices and stealing a staggering amount of money.
sentences.zh: 提交虚假发票并窃取了惊人数量的资金。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: This is something we've known about, right?
sentences.zh: 这是我们已经知道的事情，对吧？

sentences.en: This was part of the widespread fraud that we saw where pandemic programs were taken advantage of.
sentences.zh: 这是我们看到的普遍欺诈行为的一部分，当时大流行项目遭到了利用。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 正是如此。

sentences.en: And even in the context of the stunning amount of money that people stole during the pandemic
sentences.zh: 甚至在人们在大流行期间通过各种项目（包括商业贷款和失业救济金）偷走惊人数量资金的背景下，

sentences.en: are getting a wide range of programs, including business loans and unemployment benefits.
sentences.zh: 这些项目的范围也很广泛。

sentences.en: What happened in Minnesota was unique in just the scale.
sentences.zh: 明尼苏达州发生的事情在规模上是独一无二的。

sentences.en: And officials have described it as the most brazen case of its kind, just by the sheer number of people involved and the amount of money that was stolen.
sentences.zh: 官员们将其描述为同类中最厚颜无耻的案件，仅从涉案人数之多和被盗资金之巨来看就是如此。

sentences.en: How far did it actually go?
sentences.zh: 它究竟发展到了什么程度？

sentences.en: Like, what are we talking about here in terms of scale, in terms of scope?
sentences.zh: 比如说，就规模和范围而言，我们在这里谈论的是什么？

sentences.en: Well, 78 people have now been charged in the scheme in federal court.
sentences.zh: 嗯，联邦法院现在已经对该计划中的78人提出了指控。

sentences.en: The vast majority of them are Somali Americans.
sentences.zh: 其中绝大多数是索马里裔美国人。

sentences.en: More than 50 have already been convicted in these cases.
sentences.zh: 在这些案件中，已有50多人被定罪。

sentences.en: And initially, I think many local officials were outraged that this happened.
sentences.zh: 起初，我认为许多当地官员对发生这种事感到愤怒。

sentences.en: But they essentially said this probably was a one-off abuse during the pandemic when there was a real sense of urgency about getting money to people who needed it.
sentences.zh: 但他们基本上表示，这可能只是大流行期间的一次性滥用行为，当时人们确实迫切希望将钱发给需要的人。

sentences.en: However, in recent years, as prosecutors dug into court records and as they started interviewing witnesses, something really jarring came to their attention.
sentences.zh: 然而，近年来，随着检察官深入挖掘法庭记录并开始采访证人，一件非常令人震惊的事情引起了他们的注意。

sentences.en: This was not, in fact, a one-off.
sentences.zh: 这事实上并不是一次性的。

sentences.en: What they found was that networks of people had found loopholes in other programs that weren't
sentences.zh: 他们发现，人员网络在其他项目中找到了漏洞，这些项目不是新冠大流行时期的项目，

sentences.en: COVID pandemic era programs, but just run-of-the-mill safety net programs designed
sentences.zh: 而只是旨在帮助面临无家可归风险的人以及自闭症儿童的普通安全网项目，

sentences.en: to help people at risk of homelessness, kids with autism, and that they were charging a staggering amount of money for services that weren't rendered.
sentences.zh: 并且他们为并未提供的服务收取了惊人数量的费用。

sentences.en: And collectively, according to federal prosecutors, up to $1 billion has been stolen just in these three schemes.
sentences.zh: 根据联邦检察官的说法，仅在这三个计划中，被盗金额总计就高达10亿美元。

sentences.en: Remarkable.
sentences.zh: 真了不起。

sentences.en: And what state officials have said was that fraud essentially became the business model and that these people were acting kind of above board.
sentences.zh: 州官员所说的是，欺诈基本上成了商业模式，而且这些人表现得好像行得正坐得直一样。

sentences.en: They had office space that they leased all around town.
sentences.zh: 他们在城里各处租了办公空间。

sentences.en: They had websites.
sentences.zh: 他们有网站。

sentences.en: They had business cards.
sentences.zh: 他们有名片。

sentences.en: And they were sort of stealing staggering amounts of money in plain sight.
sentences.zh: 他们就在众目睽睽之下窃取惊人数量的资金。

sentences.en: And state officials tasked with overseeing and supervising these programs were just paying the invoices that came in.
sentences.zh: 而负责监督和管理这些项目的州官员只是在支付寄来的发票。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: I spoke to a defense lawyer who has represented people involved in some of these schemes, and
sentences.zh: 我采访了一位曾代表参与其中一些计划的人的辩护律师，

sentences.en: he said that among the people who were stealing money, over the years, they kind of came to
sentences.zh: 他说，在那些偷钱的人当中，多年来，他们渐渐认为利用这些资金变得太容易了，

sentences.en: think that it had become so easy to tap into these funds and, you know, get rich fraudulently
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道的，通过欺诈发财也太容易了，

sentences.en: that they kind of assumed state officials were tolerating this, if not outright authorizing it.
sentences.zh: 以至于他们甚至以为州官员是在容忍这种行为，如果不是公开授权的话。

sentences.en: And the way he described it was, you know, it was like people were stealing from the cookie jar one day, and the next morning, they had refilled it.
sentences.zh: 他对此的描述是，你知道的，这就好比人们今天从饼干罐里偷饼干，第二天早上它又被填满了。

sentences.en: You're saying this went far beyond just pandemic fraud and that almost everyone involved in these schemes was Somali-Americans.
sentences.zh: 你是说这远远超出了大流行欺诈的范畴，而且几乎所有参与这些计划的人都是索马里裔美国人。

sentences.en: But if the figures were so big, how did it go unnoticed?
sentences.zh: 但如果数字这么大，怎么会没有引起注意呢？

sentences.en: That is a great question that state officials are really struggling to answer.
sentences.zh: 这是一个很好的问题，州官员们正在努力寻找答案。

sentences.en: But I think it's useful to go back in time a little bit and kind of remember the context in which this took hold.
sentences.zh: 但我觉得稍微回顾一下过去，记住这件事情扎根时的背景是很有用的。

sentences.en: So there were red flags that emerged in 2020 when money was gushing into this program to feed children.
sentences.zh: 所以在2020年，当资金如潮水般涌入这个儿童供餐项目时，就出现了危险信号。

sentences.en: And when state officials felt overwhelmed by the sheer number of business owners who wanted in on the program, who wanted to be serving meals and be reimbursed for them, and when
sentences.zh: 当州官员对那些想要加入该项目、想要提供餐食并获得报销的庞大企业主数量感到不知所措时，

sentences.en: they started reviewing the invoices that were coming to them, they had questions.
sentences.zh: 当他们开始审查寄来的发票时，他们产生了疑问。

sentences.en: And those questions were met with an extraordinary accusation.
sentences.zh: 而这些疑问遭到了一种非同寻常的指责。

sentences.en: Which was what?
sentences.zh: 是什么指责？

sentences.en: The largest group that was organizing meal providers in this program was called Feeding
sentences.zh: 在这个项目中组织餐食供应商的最大组织被称为“喂养我们的未来”。

sentences.en: Our Future.
sentences.zh: 喂养我们的未来。

sentences.en: It was a nonprofit organization.
sentences.zh: 这是一个非营利组织。

sentences.en: And in response to questions from state officials, they essentially said the state was slow-walking
sentences.zh: 作为对州官员提问的回应，他们基本上表示，州政府在拖延处理那些想要加入该项目的人的新申请，

sentences.en: this new petition for people who wanted in on the program because they were being racist against East African immigrants.
sentences.zh: 因为他们在对东非移民搞种族歧视。

sentences.en: And I think it's useful to remember what was happening in the state at the time.
sentences.zh: 我想回想一下当时该州正在发生的事情是很有用的。

sentences.en: This fight is unfolding as Minnesota is grappling with the aftermath of the killing of George
sentences.zh: 这场争端展开的同时，明尼苏达州正疲于应付乔治·弗洛伊德遇害后的余波，

sentences.en: Floyd, which, of course, set off a national reckoning over race.
sentences.zh: 这当然在全国范围内引发了一场关于种族问题的清算。

sentences.en: So in this state at that time, nobody wanted to be called a racist, even if it was wholly unfounded.
sentences.zh: 所以在当时的这个州，没有人愿意被叫做种族主义者，即使这种指控完全毫无根据。

sentences.en: And I think the consensus now among people who have watched the sequence of events was that
sentences.zh: 我认为现在那些目睹了这一系列事件的人的共识是，

sentences.en: that really had a paralyzing effect on people in state government who knew something funny was going on, but didn't really want to stick their necks out and stop it.
sentences.zh: 这确实对州政府里那些知道有什么不对劲、但又不想出头去阻止它的人产生了麻痹效应。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: This was happening in a very particular place at a very particular time when tensions over race are extremely high.
sentences.zh: 这发生在一个非常特殊的地点、一个种族紧张局势极其高涨的非常特殊的时期。

sentences.en: But I think there's another layer to this, and that is that Somali Americans have become politically quite powerful in the state.

sentences.en: So it is, at this point, a place that's doing some soul searching about what happens when,
sentences.zh: 所以，此时此刻，这是一个正在进行深刻反思的地方，反思当

sentences.en: Ernesto, you just told us that things on the ground in Minnesota have taken a very different turn since Trump started to focus on this.
sentences.zh: 埃内斯托，你刚才告诉我们，自从特朗普开始关注此事以来，明尼苏达州的实地情况发生了非常大的转变。

sentences.en: And I want to understand that.
sentences.zh: 我想了解这一点。

sentences.en: But first, can we just get to the question of why Trump decided to seize on this right now?
sentences.zh: 但首先，我们能先探讨一下特朗普为什么决定现在就抓住这个不放吗？

sentences.en: Because you've described this scandal that's been playing out in the background for a while now, for years, with this steady drumbeat of revelations coming out over time.
sentences.zh: 因为你曾描述过，这个丑闻已经在幕后酝酿了一段时间，持续了好几年，各种内幕随着时间推移源源不断地被爆出。

sentences.en: Yeah, I think there were a sequence of events that turned this into a front burner issue for the White House.
sentences.zh: 是的，我认为有一连串事件让这成为了白宫首要关注的议题。

sentences.en: The first one was a report by Chris Ruffo, the conservative activist, which created the inference that some of the money that had been stolen in these schemes in Minnesota had
sentences.zh: 第一件事是保守派活动人士克里斯·鲁福（Chris Ruffo）的一份报告，该报告暗示明尼苏达州这些骗局中被盗的部分资金

sentences.en: wound up in the hands of terrorists in Africa, namely members of the group Al-Shabaab in Somalia.
sentences.zh: 最终落入了非洲恐怖分子手中，也就是索马里“青年党”（Al-Shabaab）成员的手里。

sentences.en: So this is a figure who has taken on universities and has become very influential in conservative circles.
sentences.zh: 所以这是一个曾与大学交锋并在保守派圈子里极具影响力的人物。

sentences.en: So the fact that he drew attention to this made it land in Washington, D.C.
sentences.zh: 因此，他提请人们注意这件事，使其引起了华盛顿特区的关注

sentences.en: — And Ruffo here is specifically saying that this money from the fraud, that it has a link to terrorism.
sentences.zh: ——而鲁福在这里明确表示，这笔诈骗资金与恐怖主义有关联。

sentences.en: — That's right.
sentences.zh: ——没错。

sentences.en: And to be clear, prosecutors have drawn no such link.
sentences.zh: 需要说明的是，检察官并未得出这样的关联。

sentences.en: None of these federal cases have featured any link whatsoever to terrorism.
sentences.zh: 所有这些联邦案件中，都没有出现任何与恐怖主义有关联的迹象。

sentences.en: But nonetheless, the headline on this piece was, quote, the largest funder of Al-Shabaab is the Minnesota taxpayer.
sentences.zh: 但尽管如此，这篇文章的标题是：引述，“青年党”最大的金主是明尼苏达州的纳税人。

sentences.en: — Wow.
Okay.
sentences.zh: 好吧。

sentences.en: So that got a lot of attention, whether it was true or not.
sentences.zh: 所以无论真假，这都引起了极大的关注。

sentences.en: — That's right.
sentences.zh: ——是的。

sentences.en: And then a few days later, we published a piece that walked readers through how fraud
sentences.zh: 随后几天，我们发表了一篇文章，向读者剖析了欺诈行为是如何在明尼苏达州

sentences.en: got so pervasive in Minnesota and that examined the role racism and politics played in allowing it to metastasize over the years.
sentences.zh: 变得如此普遍的，并审视了种族主义和政治在多年来助长其恶化中所起的作用。

sentences.en: And all this was happening at the same time as people in the nation's capital were reeling from that horrific shooting of two members of the National Guard.
sentences.zh: 而这一切发生的同时，美国首都的人们正为两名国民警卫队员遭枪击的惨剧而震惊不已。

sentences.en: The gunman in that case was an Afghan man who had been admitted in recent years into the country.
sentences.zh: 那起案件中的枪手是一名近年来获准入境美国的阿富汗男子。

sentences.en: And I think that added an element that the administration had more political cover to be more draconian in its immigration crackdown, particularly as it pertained to countries that
sentences.zh: 我认为这增添了一种因素，使得政府在移民打击力度上拥有更多政治掩护，可以采取更严厉的手段，特别是针对那些

sentences.en: are riven with instability and conflict.
sentences.zh: 充斥着不稳定和冲突的国家。

sentences.en: — Right.
sentences.zh: ——没错。

sentences.en: This has really become a moment where the administration has turned its focus to specific groups of immigrants from places that, as you said, have a reputation for instability, for

sentences.en: conflict.
sentences.zh: 冲突。

sentences.en: And the message the White House has been sending about these people is that they're importing cultures into America that are not welcome.

sentences.en: And then in his comments on Tuesday, Trump seems to pick up right where Miller left off.
sentences.zh: 然后在周二的评论中，特朗普似乎紧接着米勒的话头往下说。

sentences.en: — That's right.
sentences.zh: ——没错。

sentences.en: And the desire by President Trump and people in his circle to limit immigration from specific
sentences.zh: 特朗普总统及其核心圈子想要限制来自特定国家的移民的愿望

sentences.en: countries dates back to his first term, obviously, and was met with tremendous pushback, both from the public and from the courts.
sentences.zh: 显然可以追溯到他的第一个任期，当时遭到了公众和法院的强烈阻挠。

sentences.en: — I think now, though, they may feel that they have a little more leverage to push this through,
sentences.zh: ——不过我想现在，他们可能觉得自己在推动这一进程、

sentences.en: to get more people in handcuffs and out of the country, and to close the door to American immigration based on nationality.
sentences.zh: 把更多人戴上手铐驱逐出境、并根据国籍关闭美国移民大门方面，有了更多的筹码。

sentences.en: And at that cabinet meeting on Tuesday, President Trump said the United States was at a crossroads.

sentences.en: — You know, our country's at a tipping point.
sentences.zh: ——你知道的，我们国家正处于引爆点。

sentences.en: — We could go bad.
sentences.zh: ——我们可能会变坏。

sentences.en: We're at a tipping point.
sentences.zh: 我们正处于引爆点。

sentences.en: I don't know if people mind me saying that, but I'm saying that we could go one way or the other.
sentences.zh: 我不知道人们是否介意我这么说，但我认为我们可能会走向任何一个方向。

sentences.en: — He said that he was fed up with people coming here from impoverished, conflict-ridden countries, and as he sees it, leeching off the welfare state.
sentences.zh: ——他说，他受够了那些来自贫困、冲突不断国家的人来到这里，并且在他看来，是在吸福利社会的血。

sentences.en: — The welfare is like 88 percent.
sentences.zh: ——福利高达88%。

sentences.en: They contribute nothing.
sentences.zh: 他们毫无贡献。

sentences.en: I don't want them in our country, I'll be honest with you, OK?
sentences.zh: 老实跟你说，我不想让他们来我们国家，好吗？

sentences.en: Some of you say, oh, that's not politically correct.
sentences.zh: 你们有些人会说，哦，这政治不正确。

sentences.en: I don't care.
sentences.zh: 我不在乎。

sentences.en: I don't want them in our country.
sentences.zh: 我就是不想让他们来我们国家。

sentences.en: Their country is no good for a reason.
sentences.zh: 他们的国家不好是有原因的。

sentences.en: Their country stinks.
sentences.zh: 他们的国家糟糕透顶。

sentences.en: — It also just strikes me that this is all happening, this conversation, so much more out in the open than it was in Trump's first term.
sentences.zh: ——我还注意到，这一切都在发生，这种对话比特朗普第一任期时更加公开。

sentences.en: I mean, I think a lot of us will remember the comment that Trump made about shithole countries.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我想我们很多人都还记得特朗普关于那些粪坑国家的言论。

sentences.en: That was behind closed doors.
sentences.zh: 那是闭门进行的。

sentences.en: That was a comment made in private that was later revealed.
sentences.zh: 那是私下发表后来被曝光的言论。

sentences.en: Now he's doing this in front of his cabinet, in front of the cameras rolling.
sentences.zh: 现在他当着内阁的面、在滚动的摄像机前这么做。

sentences.en: — Yeah, I think there's a sense that in this current era, they feel emboldened to say the quiet part out loud
sentences.zh: ——是的，我认为现在有一种感觉，在这个时期，他们觉得有底气把不能宣之于口的话大声说出来

sentences.en: and to say things that would have been unimaginable and career-ending for mainstream politicians in the not-too-distant paSt.
sentences.zh: 并说出那些在不久前对主流政治家来说简直不可想象且会断送政治生涯的话。

sentences.en: But all of a sudden, we are seeing these ideas and these notions become mainstream policies and mainstream subjects of debate.
sentences.zh: 但突然之间，我们看到这些观点和看法成为了主流政策和主流辩论的主题。

sentences.en: — And to be clear, the people that Trump is talking about here are Somalis, most of whom you've told us have legal status or are citizens.
sentences.zh: ——需要明确的是，特朗普在这里谈论的人是索马里人，正如你所说，他们大多数拥有合法身份或已是公民。

sentences.en: So I want to ask, given that, what do you expect the ICE operations to look like there?
sentences.zh: 所以我想问，鉴于此，你预计那里的移民及海关执法局（ICE）行动会是什么样的？

sentences.en: I mean, what are they going to do?
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，他们会怎么做？

sentences.en: Who are they looking for?
sentences.zh: 他们在找谁？

sentences.en: — Yeah, I think this is a very challenging mission for ICE,
sentences.zh: ——是的，我认为这对ICE来说是一个极具挑战性的任务，

sentences.en: and I think it's likely to look very different from what we've seen earlier this year in places like Chicago or Los Angeles.
sentences.zh: 而且我认为这很可能与我们今年早些时候在芝加哥或洛杉矶等地看到的景象截然不同。

sentences.en: You know, for starters, the number of people who may be subject to deportation appears to be pretty small.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，首先，可能面临驱逐出境的人数似乎相当少。

sentences.en: We may be talking about just a few hundred people who may have outstanding deportation orders and who can sort of be put into the system.
sentences.zh: 我们可能只是在谈论区区几百人，他们身上可能有未执行的驱逐令，并且可以被纳入这个系统中。

sentences.en: And there's kind of a more mundane challenge, and that is that this week has been bone-chilling in Minnesota, and people are spending as little time as possible on the streets,
sentences.zh: 还有一个更世俗的挑战，那就是这周明尼苏达州寒冷刺骨，人们尽量减少在街头停留的时间，

sentences.en: and agents, I think, are facing real pain.
sentences.zh: 而且我认为特工们也面临着真正的痛苦。

sentences.en: If they're out and about, knocking on doors, staking out businesses and residences, that in and of itself is going to be a monumental challenge for ICE.
sentences.zh: 如果他们四处奔波、挨家挨户敲门、监视商铺和住宅，对ICE来说，光是这一点就是一项巨大的挑战。

sentences.en: — Can we pull back here for a minute?
sentences.zh: ——我们能退一步谈谈吗？

sentences.en: Because it's worth saying what we're seeing here isn't just an immigration operation.
sentences.zh: 因为值得一提的是，我们在这里看到的不仅仅是一场移民行动。

sentences.en: Trump's comments and these actions seem to be just as much about delegitimizing a group of people who either emigrated here and became American citizens or their parents did.
sentences.zh: 特朗普的言论和这些行动似乎同样旨在抹去某一群体的人的合法性，他们要么移民到这里并成为了美国公民，要么他们的父母这么做了。

sentences.en: The president is calling into question their Americanness and really calling into question whether your ability as an immigrant or a child of immigrants
sentences.zh: 总统正在质疑他们的美国属性，并且真正在质疑作为移民或移民子女的你

sentences.en: to call yourself an American depends on where you're from.
sentences.zh: 是否有资格称自己为美国人，这取决于你来自哪里。

sentences.en: — Yeah, I think this is a really painful question that Somali immigrants are now wrestling with is, you know, what do you do to prove that you're an American?
sentences.zh: ——是的，我认为索马里移民现在正在纠结一个非常痛苦的问题，那就是：你究竟该怎么做才能证明自己是个美国人？

sentences.en: Like, to what lengths do you need to go to truly feel like you belong and that you're part of the fabric of this nation?
sentences.zh: 比如，你需要付出多大努力才能真正觉得自己属于这里，是这个国家社会结构的一部分？

sentences.en: We're talking about people in many cases who were born here and have known no other homeland.
sentences.zh: 在许多情况下，我们谈论的是在这里出生、不知道还有第二个祖国的人。

sentences.en: Others arrived here decades ago and have long considered themselves patriots who have been helping build the state, paying taxes, working in really difficult jobs.
sentences.zh: 其他人则是几十年前来到这里，长期以来一直认为自己是爱国者，他们一直在建设这个州、纳税、从事非常艰苦的工作。

sentences.en: So, yeah, I think this really leaves people with unsettling questions about what they need to do to be brought into the fold of this country in this political era.
sentences.zh: 所以，是的，我认为这确实给人们留下了令人不安的疑问：在这个政治时代，他们究竟需要做些什么才能融入这个国家。

sentences.en: And just how much further will this crackdown and this cloud of suspicion reach?
sentences.zh: 这场打击行动和怀疑的阴云究竟还会波及多远？

sentences.en: What shape could this take in the months ahead?
sentences.zh: 在未来的几个月里，这会演变成什么形状？

sentences.en: — And I'd imagine whether their Americanness could be called into question any time a single or a few members of their community make a mistake.
sentences.zh: ——我猜，只要他们社区中哪怕一个人或少数人犯了错，他们的美国属性就随时可能受到质疑。

sentences.en: — Absolutely.
sentences.zh: ——完全正确。

sentences.en: You know, we've heard from local elected officials who say they're deeply concerned that the stage is set for widespread civil rights violations.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，我们听到当地民选官员表示，他们深感担忧，认为这为大规模侵犯民权行为埋下了伏笔。

sentences.en: — The vast majority of our Somali community are citizens.
sentences.zh: ——我们索马里社区的绝大多数人都是公民。

sentences.en: So what he—who he just attacked isn't just Somalis.
sentences.zh: 所以他——他刚刚攻击的不仅仅是索马里人。

sentences.en: Who he attacked is Somali Americans.
sentences.zh: 他攻击的是索马里裔美国人。

sentences.en: Who he attacked is Americans.
sentences.zh: 他攻击的是美国人。

sentences.en: — St. Paul Mayor Melvin Carter looked back to history.
sentences.zh: ——圣保罗市长梅尔文·卡特（Melvin Carter）回顾了历史。

sentences.en: — I believe that the sacred moments in American history are the moments we've had to decide who gets to be included in the we.
sentences.zh: ——我相信美国历史上神圣的时刻，就是我们不得不决定谁能被纳入“我们”之中的时刻。

sentences.en: Do we mean Black people?
sentences.zh: 我们是指黑人吗？

sentences.en: Do we mean women?
sentences.zh: 我们是指女性吗？

sentences.en: Do we mean immigrants?
sentences.zh: 我们是指移民吗？

sentences.en: Who is a part of the we when we say we the people?
sentences.zh: 当我们说“我们人民”时，谁是“我们”的一部分？

sentences.en: — And he said we should be thinking of this moment as one that may define who we are as Americans and as a nation.
sentences.zh: ——他说，我们应该把这个时刻看作是一个可能会定义我们作为美国人和作为国家之身份的时刻。

sentences.en: — And Ernesto, what about the reckoning that you described happening in Minnesota around the original scandal that prompted all of this, the fraud?
sentences.zh: ——埃内斯托，关于你所描述的明尼苏达州围绕引发这一切的最初丑闻——欺诈行为——所展开的反思，情况如何？

sentences.en: I mean, you had said that the state was really starting to have a conversation about how this fear of being perceived as racist or called racist, the fear of a backlash, had led to
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，你曾说过该州真的开始展开对话，探讨这种害怕被视为种族主义者或被称为种族主义者、害怕遭到反噬的恐惧，是如何导致

sentences.en: this very well-intentioned system being totally corrupted.
sentences.zh: 这个本意良好的系统彻底腐化的。

sentences.en: Where does that conversation stand now?
sentences.zh: 这场对话现在进展到什么地步了？

sentences.en: — Yeah, it's going to be fascinating to watch how this unfolds in the months ahead.
sentences.zh: ——是的，看着这一切在未来几个月如何展开将是非常引人入胜的。

sentences.en: — You know, on the one hand, we're in a moment where nobody can turn a blind eye to the fact that fraud is a huge and systemic problem for Minnesota.
sentences.zh: ——你知道的，一方面，我们正处于这样一个时刻：没有人可以对欺诈是明尼苏达州一个巨大且系统性问题这一事实视而不见。

sentences.en: There's going to be a governor's election next year.
sentences.zh: 明年将举行州长选举。

sentences.en: And Tim Walz, who's a Democrat, could lose that race if the people who are challenging him
sentences.zh: 如果那些来自共和党、在右翼挑战他的候选人

sentences.en: on the right from the Republican Party succeed in making fraud the defining issue in the race.
sentences.zh: 成功地将欺诈变成竞选中的决定性议题，那么身为民主党人的蒂姆·沃尔兹（Tim Walz）可能会输掉这场选举。

sentences.en: — I think there's broad agreement that you need systemic change and that you need strong safeguards.
sentences.zh: ——我认为各方广泛达成的一致是，你需要系统性变革，你需要强有力的防范措施。

sentences.en: And I think also we're starting to see a reckoning among people in the Somali community about
sentences.zh: 而且我认为我们也开始看到索马里社区的人们开始反思

sentences.en: the fact that this is a big problem and has created a significant perception issue that many people are now paying the price for.
sentences.zh: 这样一个事实：这是一个大问题，并造成了严重的公众形象问题，许多人现在为此付出了代价。

sentences.en: — But just as, you know, Minnesota seemed ready to start having a more frank and constructive
sentences.zh: ——但正当明尼苏达州似乎准备开始就种族问题展开更坦诚、更有建设性的对话之际，

sentences.en: conversation about race, and even to just talk about the fact that Somalis were largely responsible
sentences.zh: 甚至只是探讨索马里人对这些欺诈案件负主要责任这一事实时，

sentences.en: for these cases of fraud, it's now been bulldozed by the debate over immigration and the xenophobic rhetoric that we're hearing from the president.
sentences.zh: 它现在却被移民辩论以及我们从总统那里听到的排外言论给彻底摧毁了。

sentences.en: — Right.
sentences.zh: ——没错。

sentences.en: — It's going to be really hard to disentangle these two issues.
sentences.zh: ——要厘清这两个问题将非常困难。

sentences.en: And I think the pragmatic change that, you know, will likely happen in the months ahead is going to be really hard to divorce from the national politics.
sentences.zh: 我认为，你知道，未来几个月可能会发生的务实变革，将很难与国家政治脱钩。

sentences.en: — Well, Ernesto, thanks so much.
sentences.zh: ——好的，埃尔内斯托，非常感谢。

sentences.en: — Natalie, it's been a pleasure.
sentences.zh: ——娜塔莉，这是我的荣幸。

sentences.en: — We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: ——我们马上回来。

sentences.en: — Here's what else you need to know today.
sentences.zh: ——以下是你今天还需要了解的内容。

sentences.en: — On Wednesday, President Trump announced a plan to weaken fuel efficiency requirements for tens of millions of new cars and light trucks, calling them a scam.
sentences.zh: ——周三，特朗普总统宣布了一项计划，旨在削弱数千万辆新轿车和轻型卡车的燃油效率标准，并称其为一场骗局。

sentences.en: It was his latest move to gut fuel restrictions put in place by the Biden administration to help address climate change.
sentences.zh: 这是他旨在废除拜登政府为应对气候变化而实施的燃油限制的最新举措。

sentences.en: Trump said the efficiency requirements made cars too costly for automakers to build and too expensive for Americans to buy.
sentences.zh: 特朗普表示，燃油效率标准使得汽车对汽车制造商而言制造成本过高，对美国人而言购买价格昂贵。

sentences.en: The administration claimed the new rules would shave $1,000 off the cost of a new car.
sentences.zh: 该政府声称，新规将使新车的购车成本削减1000美元。

sentences.en: And in a report that's scheduled to be released on Thursday, the Pentagon's acting inspector
sentences.zh: 根据计划于周四发布的报告，五角大楼的代理总督察

sentences.en: general said that Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth brisked endangering American troops earlier this year when he used a private messaging app to discuss military plans.
sentences.zh: 表示，国防部长皮特·海格塞斯今年早些时候在使用私人通讯软件讨论军事计划时，险些危及美国士兵的安全。

sentences.en: The Pentagon's internal inquiry centered on Hegseth's role in a group chat on Signal, the encrypted
sentences.zh: 五角大楼的内部调查集中于海格塞斯在加密通讯软件Signal的一个群聊中所扮演的角色，

sentences.en: messaging app, where he discussed imminent strikes in Yemen with other senior Trump officials.
sentences.zh: 他在该群聊中与其他特朗普高级官员讨论了对也门的迫在眉睫的打击行动。

sentences.en: The chat became public because a journalist was added to the group by mistake.
sentences.zh: 由于一名记者被错误地拉入该群聊，这个群聊的内容得以公开。

sentences.en: Today's episode was produced by Diana Nguyen, Nina Feldman, and Stella Tan.
sentences.zh: 今天的节目由戴安娜·阮、妮娜·费尔德曼和斯特拉·陈制作。

sentences.en: It was edited by M.J.
sentences.zh: 由M.J.

sentences.en: Davis-Lynn and Michael Benoit, contains music by Aliciava Etoop and Marion Lozano, and was engineered by Alyssa Moxley.
sentences.zh: 戴维斯-林恩和迈克尔·勒努瓦编辑，包含阿丽西亚瓦·埃托普和马里昂·洛萨诺的音乐，并由阿丽莎·莫克斯利担任音频工程。

sentences.en: For decades, the Brooklyn Democratic Party operated as a tightly controlled machine.
sentences.zh: 几十年来，布鲁克林民主党一直像一个受到严密控制的机器一样运作。

sentences.en: Until this summer, when elections ushered in a bunch of self-described reformers.
sentences.zh: 直到今年夏天，选举迎来了群自称改革派的人。

sentences.en: Ever since, the party has been in the grip of a bruising, chaotic, and sometimes thrilling fight.
sentences.zh: 自那以后，该党陷入了一场激烈、混乱且有时惊心动魄的争斗之中。

sentences.en: In the latest episode of Metro, with me, Sarah Koenig, stories of people trying to maintain their influence and losing control along the way.
sentences.zh: 在最新一期的《都市》节目中，由我，萨拉·科尼格，为您讲述人们试图维持影响力却在过程中失去控制的故事。

sentences.en: Metro.
sentences.zh: 《都市》。

sentences.en: Listen wherever you get your podcasts.
sentences.zh: 请在各大播客平台收听。
